summary: Recover governed PR delivery from GraphQL rate limits

delivery.outcome: Recover governed PR observation and creation through exact-repository REST when GitHub GraphQL reports rate exhaustion. Preserve non-forced push, canonical/legacy alias reconciliation, duplicate rejection and current pushed HEAD verification. Publish the material fix through independent protected merge.
nonGoals: Bypass reviews, tests, policy or Git push authorization
Change delivery configuration, version, release or runtime dependencies
Retry ordinary authentication, validation or network failures through another effectful transport

architecture.decision: Keep the existing gh PR transport. Recognize only explicit GraphQL rate exhaustion. Resolve the configured github.com remote exactly, query open/base/head through REST, validate returned bindings, and reconcile possible successful creation before at most one structured REST POST. Always verify current HEAD with the existing observer.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected publication; preserve independent receipts.

validation.evidence: Explicit GraphQL exhaustion recovers through REST without duplicate creation or mismatched repository/base/head.
Existing bounded resume, ordinary failures and authorized non-forced push remain enforced; exact-head OneDev and independent protected publication pass.
